title: Fungal Tremor
description: The ground shudders beneath your feet and the mushroom stalks sway drunkenly. Somewhere deep below, the mycelium network is shifting -- massive root systems rearranging in response to something. Spore clouds burst from the walls and ceiling, filling the passage with glowing dust. The tremor could bring the tunnel down, or it might pass.

choices.label: Sprint through
choices.description: Dash past the unstable section before it collapses.

outcomes.text: You sprint through the shaking tunnel and spot a coin pouch dropped by a previous explorer. Snatched mid-stride -- not bad.
You make it through, and the tremor shakes loose a cluster of materials from a collapsed pack embedded in the wall.
A section of ceiling gives way as you run. Rocks and fungal debris crash down around you. You make it through battered and coughing.

choices.label: Shelter under a cap
choices.description: Duck beneath a giant mushroom cap and wait for the tremor to pass.

outcomes.text: The tremor passes and the mushroom cap held firm. The rest does your party good -- everyone catches their breath.
The cap shelters you perfectly, and as the tremor subsides you notice spore clusters shaken loose from the ceiling above.
The cap splits under falling debris, showering everyone in spore dust. You're safe from the rocks, but breathing is agony.

choices.label: Retreat carefully
choices.description: Back away slowly. Better safe than buried.

outcomes.text: You back away as the tunnel groans and shifts. A section ahead collapses moments later. Wise choice.
